description: Items obtainable from fishing treasure chests. Hardcoded in Stardew source (GameLocation.getFishingTreasure) — not data-driven, so this is a hand-curated list sourced from https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Fishing#Contents. Chance values are approximate per-chest probabilities for regular treasure chests as listed on the wiki. Used by ProcessGameData.cjs to emit `fishing-chest` source rows.
